prompt:
We need an executable brownfield architecture for the Chicago VCF estate, not a prose upgrade explainer. Build a PowerShell module as `VcfArchitecture/VcfArchitecture.psd1` and `VcfArchitecture/VcfArchitecture.psm1`. The module must use the preinstalled `VMware.Sdk.Vcf` PowerCLI modules for live SDDC Manager inventory (do not vendor any VMware module), and it must also generate the design deterministically from `fixtures/estate-inventory.json`.

Research the supported source/target combinations, component interoperability, and upgrade path using genuine live Broadcom-published compatibility, interoperability, documentation, or knowledge sources with your available network tools. Record what you actually consulted as a JSON array in `research-notes.json`; each entry must have nonempty `title`, `url`, `accessed`, and `conclusion` strings, with a reachable HTTPS official-source URL and an ISO `YYYY-MM-DD` access date. Do not rely on search snippets alone. Live material may change; `specifications/compatibility-snapshot.json` is the pinned acceptance authority for the artifact, so note any live discrepancy but make the generated plan match that snapshot. Offline acceptance checks the audit record's structure and official-source URLs, not the changing live conclusions.

Generate `architecture/migration-plan.json`. This is an existing-estate design: it must select between the stated OSA and ESA options, express the resulting host-count and network design, and use the supported side-by-side storage transition rather than implying an in-place OSA-to-ESA conversion. Include an ordered step for every component in the inventory, naming its current version, target, action, and the concrete prerequisite gates controlling that step. Include only supported VCF upgrade hops. The plan must contain `targetSddcSpec`, and that object must validate as `#/components/schemas/SddcSpec` from the unmodified installer OpenAPI document at `specifications/vcf-installer/vcf-installer-openapi.json` (the copy from tag `9.1.0.0` of `vmware/vcf-api-specs`). Use `VCF_COMPLETE`, reuse the existing vCenter, and use the literal non-secret placeholder `REDACTED-FIXTURE` where the installer schema requires `rootVcenterPassword`. The complete plan must also validate against `specifications/migration-plan.schema.json`.

The module manifest must declare `VMware.Sdk.Vcf.SddcManager` as a prerequisite and export `Get-VcfEstateInventory` and `New-VcfMigrationPlan`. `Get-VcfEstateInventory` must accept `-Server` and `-Credential`, connect with `Connect-VcfSddcManagerServer`, collect domains, clusters, hosts, and vCenters with the corresponding official `Get-Sddc*` cmdlets, return them under `server`, `domains`, `clusters`, `hosts`, and `vcenters`, and disconnect in all cases. `New-VcfMigrationPlan` must accept `-InventoryPath`, `-CompatibilitySnapshotPath`, and `-OutputPath` and write stable JSON. Do not put credentials or genuine secrets in the artifact. Run `pwsh -NoProfile -File tests/verify.ps1` for offline acceptance.
